## Detailed Findings

#### 1. Kilocode #13306: Agent-manager edit preview in side panel (LOW/SKIP)

- **What**: Desktop agent-manager side panel UI for previewing edits before applying. Side panel layout shows pending file changes with diff preview, accept/reject controls, and live updates as agent proposes edits.
- **Why**: Desktop users want to review proposed changes before applying them to their project.
- **Source**: https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/13306 (Kilocode #13306)
- **Category**: tool (UI/desktop)
- **Size**: LOW (desktop feature, Alexi is CLI-only with NO desktop GUI, NO agent-manager, NO side panel UI, SKIP - not CLI-portable).

#### 2. Kilocode #13221: Durable PTY processes across reloads (LOW/SKIP)

- **What**: Agent-manager PTY lifecycle management to prevent PTY processes escaping worktree cleanup. Fixes PTYs staying alive after worktree reload/cleanup, leaking processes.
- **Why**: Desktop agent-manager worktree cleanup should not leak background processes.
- **Source**: https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/13221 (Kilocode #13221)
- **Category**: tool (agent-manager/desktop)
- **Size**: LOW (agent-manager worktree PTY lifecycle, Alexi has NO agent-manager, NO worktrees beyond git native, NO PTY process tracking tied to worktree lifecycle, SKIP - not CLI-portable).

#### 3. Kilocode #13309: Colon-prefixed model search (LOW/SKIP)

- **What**: Model selector UI fix for matching colon-prefixed names like `sap-ai-core:anthropic--claude-4.7-opus`. Search was breaking on colon delimiter, failing to match full model IDs with provider prefix.
- **Why**: VSCode model picker should find models with colon-prefixed provider namespaces.
- **Source**: https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/13309 (Kilocode #13309)
- **Category**: command (UI fix)
- **Size**: LOW (VSCode model selector UI search fix, Alexi CLI `models` command uses table output not searchable UI, model IDs already support colon prefix in routing-config.json and are matched by exact string, SKIP - not CLI-portable).

#### 4. Kilocode #13304: Agent-manager multi-project session state scoping (LOW/SKIP)

- **What**: Desktop agent-manager multi-project session state isolation. Fixes session state leaking across projects when agent-manager manages multiple worktrees.
- **Why**: Desktop agent-manager should not mix session state between different projects.
- **Source**: https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/13304 (Kilocode #13304)
- **Category**: config (agent-manager session)
- **Size**: LOW (desktop agent-manager multi-project session scoping, Alexi CLI sessions are single-project via workdir context stored at session creation, NO agent-manager, NO multi-project worktree orchestration, SKIP - not CLI-portable).

#### 5. Kilocode #11611: Provider usage center (MODERATE/SKIP - already covered)

- **What**: VSCode UI feature for tracking provider usage, costs, rate limits, and quota across models. Dashboard shows aggregated stats per provider with drilldown per model.
- **Why**: Users want visibility into their API usage and costs across multiple providers.
- **Source**: https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/11611 (Kilocode #11611)
- **Category**: tool (usage tracking/UI)
- **Size**: MODERATE (Alexi has NO usage tracking beyond in-memory telemetry stub at src/utils/telemetry.ts L1-65 with "in a production system this would send to a telemetry service" comment, pattern valuable for CLI usage reports like `alexi usage --provider sap-ai-core --model opus` or `alexi sessions --with-usage` but needs telemetry infrastructure first, defer pending observability strategy, SKIP for immediate action - already covered in previous research cycles).

#### 6. Cline #13498: Auto-approve all MCP tools when MCP toggle is on (LOW/SKIP)

- **What**: VSCode setting UX improvement where the global "Use MCP servers" auto-approve toggle now governs ALL MCP tools unconditionally, instead of requiring both the toggle AND each tool's per-tool autoApprove flag. Simplifies UX: toggle alone now controls MCP auto-approval, per-tool flag no longer consulted.
- **Why**: Users expected toggling MCP auto-approve to work immediately, but it appeared to do nothing because each tool required individual opt-in.
- **Source**: https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/13498 (Cline #13498)
- **Category**: mcp (approval policy)
- **Size**: LOW (Alexi src/mcp/ has server lifecycle (src/mcp/client.ts L1-400) + transport (src/mcp/transport.ts L1-200) but NO per-tool approval policies yet, NO auto-approve toggle, NO per-tool autoApprove flags - MCP tools are executed without approval gates currently, pattern only relevant if Alexi adds MCP approval system where users can gate MCP tool execution on per-tool or per-server basis, SKIP for now).

#### 7. Cline #13489: Emit task.completed from every session teardown path (LOW/SKIP)

- **What**: Telemetry correctness fix routing task.completed event through unified choke point `emitTaskCompletedOnTeardown` called from both shutdownSession and releaseSessionRuntime. Interactive sessions with terminal-reported status were going through releaseSessionRuntime which never emitted, silently dropping the completion event. Now enforces exactly one task.completed per session with `taskCompletedEmitted` flag.
- **Why**: Telemetry needs accurate session completion events for every session teardown path, not just non-interactive ones.
- **Source**: https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/13489 (Cline #13489)
- **Category**: tool (telemetry)
- **Size**: LOW (Alexi src/utils/telemetry.ts L1-65 has in-memory stub with NO task.completed events, NO session teardown telemetry, comment "in a production system this would send to a telemetry service", pattern N/A until telemetry strategy implemented, SKIP).
